title: React State Race Condition in ToolConfirmationMessage Causing Duplicate Renderings

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue gives a clear and actionable report of a React/Ink state race condition in ToolConfirmationMessage.tsx, including line references, root cause, and explanation.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Addressing Ink/React state race conditions and terminal redraw issues requires managing component lifecycle and state synchronization in interactive terminal UI components.

summary.problem: Calling handleConfirm on keypress unmounts ToolConfirmationMessage while height constraints are being calculated, causing duplicate footers and terminal visual artifacts.
summary.root_cause: The component currently uses a useEffect state bridge (isCancelling) to delay confirmation to the next render cycle instead of decoupling state changes from height constraints.
summary.context: To support renderer updates, state management in ToolConfirmationMessage must be decoupled from height constraints so component updates and unmounting resolve synchronously without visual tearing.

steps: Refactor keypress handling for Command.ESCAPE in ToolConfirmationMessage.tsx to handle cancellation directly rather than relying on an intermediate isCancelling state.
Decouple height constraint updates from component state changes to allow synchronous state transitions on confirm/cancel actions.
Remove the temporary useEffect hook and isCancelling state variable.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: ToolConfirmationMessage processes cancellation keypresses synchronously and calls confirm with ToolConfirmationOutcome.Cancel without causing height constraint desynchronization or visual rendering artifacts.
verification_steps: Run unit tests in ToolConfirmationMessage.test.tsx using Vitest to confirm cancellation and approval behaviors function as expected.
Verify ESC keypress invokes confirm handler directly without requiring an additional render cycle.
